title: Affine-space immersion attached to a quasi-affine scheme
statement:
Under the hypotheses of
[lemma-nagata-quasi-affine-immersion-affine-space-exists], choose one
witness and denote its dimension and morphism by $n$ and

$$
\iota_X\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbb A^n_S
$$

.
